description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named UserController for managing user-related operations in an admin web interface, including listing users, creating/editing users, password management, and password reset functionalities.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing user administration functions such as listing, creating, editing, password management, and password reset.

methods.name: displayUsers
methods.description: Displays the user list page, setting up the menu.

methods.name: pageUsers
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to fetch paginated list of users.

methods.name: displayChangePassword
methods.description: Displays the change password page for the current user.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Processes password change requests for the current user.

methods.name: displayUserEdit
methods.description: Displays the user edit form for a specific user by ID.

methods.name: populateUserObjects
methods.description: Populates model attributes with user groups, stores, questions, and languages for user forms.

methods.name: displayUser
methods.description: Prepares and displays the user profile/edit page.

methods.name: checkUserCode
methods.description: AJAX endpoint to check if a username is already taken.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Handles saving or updating user data, including sending notification emails on creation.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Deletes a user by ID, with authorization checks.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for views.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: AJAX endpoint to initiate password reset by username, returning security questions.

methods.name: resetPasswordSecurityQtn
methods.description: Handles password reset after security questions are answered correctly, including email notification.
